summary: Join our Results-Based Project Management Training Course to develop essential skills for planning, executing, and evaluating projects for maximum impact.
lede: Results-based project management links project resources and activities to measurable outputs, outcomes and impact. It is for project, programme and monitoring and evaluation professionals who need to plan delivery and report whether work is producing intended results. Participants practise building a Theory of Change and logframe, defining indicators and targets, checking data quality, and analyzing performance variances.
audienceIntro: This results-based project management course is designed for professionals who plan outcomes, control delivery, validate evidence, or report project performance. It supports intermediate and advanced practitioners who already work with projects and need a more rigorous connection between implementation activity and measurable results.
modules: Theory of Change and Results Chains
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop capable of running spreadsheet software and Power BI Desktop where installation policies permit. The course provides practice datasets and editable templates. Completion requires working knowledge of project planning and basic spreadsheet formulas, while advanced evaluation and AI-assisted analysis are taught at conceptual or operational application level rather than technical engineering depth.
